value: The agent has read-only access to analytics and repository content.
It cannot publish, send outreach, edit robots/canonicals or expose secrets.
Every recommendation must cite a page, metric row or policy source.
A human owner approves, edits and implements accepted changes.
What is the bounded goal and stop condition?
Which tools and data does the agent actually need?
Which actions need preview, approval or prohibition?
How will quality, drift, value and incidents be measured?
